findings.reason: Reviewed the full candidate, the exact article, dossier, and attached scan (PDF p. 739 / printed p. 726). The glyph sequence is visibly presented under 北, but the identities of the individual historical specimens have not been verified against their cited source works and remain unresolved. No article or dossier claim depends on or uses any individual specimen identity: the article discusses the back-to-back conception and broad script history using separate study and dictionary evidence, and the cited 字源 record supports its own report rather than independently identifying the specimens.

identity_observations.support_reason: No article or dossier claim depends on or uses an individual identity assigned to the unresolved historical glyph specimens. Related graphic-history claims are supported independently by the cited Zhengzhou University study, the Shuowen entry, and the Academia Sinica database; the 字源 citation is used only for its own reported account, not as independent identification of the specimens.
